integrity: An exact analytic proof and a standalone symbolic/finite-matrix diagnostic are included. The numerical examples do not establish the infinite-volume theorem. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the isolated zero-flat-band compressed operator of an infinite Hermitian diamond chain at fixed flux \(0<\phi<\pi\), two equal real onsite impurity pairs separated by at least two plaquettes. The full physical Hamiltonian has the stated splittings only to first order in positive impurity strength; no finite-strength or uniform thermodynamic/zero-flux claim is made. A plausibly relevant doctoral thesis has not been inspected in full.
title: Exact equal-channel tunneling for separated impurities in a flux-threaded diamond chain
